label: Written by AI from public sources — may contain errors.

items.t: Publicly refused to acknowledge Biden's victory, around the time of the 2022 state Republican convention where she was chosen as the nominee for secretary of state (2022).
items.q: Monae Johnson, who publicly refused to acknowledge Biden’s victory, was tabbed for secretary of state in a landslide over incumbent Steve Barnett

items.t: Said SB 175 was the result of a good legislative process and was approved by the Legislature by a supermajority after a series of amendments.
items.q: This bill is the result of a good legislative process. After a series of amendments, the Legislature approved SB 175 by a supermajority,

items.t: Said South Dakota deserves a Secretary of State who will protect voter access and election security and support election officials.
items.q: South Dakota deserves a Secretary of State who will strengthen confidence through performance rather than provocation; who will support election officials rather than burden them for political effect; who will protect voter access and election security without pretending those goals are enemies

items.t: Said South Dakotans should look beyond party labels and vote for Democrat Terrence Davis for Secretary of State.
items.q: That is why I am asking South Dakotans, Republicans, Democrats, Libertarians, independents, and everyone in between, to look beyond the letter beside a candidate’s name, examine the record and temperament of the candidates seeking this responsibility, and vote for Terrence Davis for Secretary of State,

record.t: Issued guidance on SB 175, a new voter registration law.
record.q: Secretary of State Monae Johnson issued guidance on SB 175, a new voter registration law that was signed by Governor Larry Rhoden earlier today.

record.t: Issued a memo to state agencies and guidance to county auditors on implementing the new voter registration requirement.
record.q: A memo has been issued to each agency, and the Secretary of State has also issued guidance to county auditors to help them implement the new requirement efficiently and correctly.

record.t: Sought a criminal investigation after accusing Hansen's group of impersonating her staff.
record.q: Johnson accused Hansen’s group of “impersonating” her staff and “trying to pressure voters into asking that their name be removed” from the petitions. She sought a criminal investigation
